property_summary: For every caller and amount, if the contract has non-zero balance and an external recipient's fallback reverts when sendMoney is called by the owner forwarding some value, then only the owner can later drain the contract (address(c).balance stays > 0 after a non-owner attempt to withdraw); the mutant that removes onlyOwner allows a non-owner to withdraw and can make address(c).balance == 0 for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Relax onlyOwner check to allow any caller (remove require), so withdraw can be invoked by anyone to withdraw funds.
